## Credentials, not environment variables
This workflow uses **no `$env` at all**.

- **Paintrz Supabase service role** — a *Custom Auth* credential carrying both headers:
  `{ "headers": { "apikey": "<service-role>", "Authorization": "Bearer <service-role>" } }`
- **Paintrz Dezgo API key** — a *Header Auth* credential: name `X-Dezgo-Key`, value the Dezgo key.

Why: env vars are global to every node and every workflow, and reading them from a Code node needs `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`, which exposes **every** secret to **every** Code node. Credentials are scoped per node, are never readable from Code, and rotate in one place with no redeploy.

The Supabase URL is hardcoded because it is not a secret — it is already public in app.html.

## Colour pass runs in the image service
The LAB correction and branding moved to the **paintrzaip2p** service at
`http://paintrzaip2p.railway.internal:8080/correct`, over Railway private networking.

jimp is gone. Code nodes execute in a separate `@n8n/task-runner` process that dies outright when jimp is required, and n8n cannot scale past one replica while a volume is attached. `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL` is no longer needed for this pipeline.

The schema needs `decrement_credit(uid)` and `increment_credits(uid, amount)` — the refund path uses the second.

The `photos` bucket must be **public**, or the `/public/` URLs written back will 404.

## Credit is taken BEFORE the render
Checked and charged up front, so two submissions racing on one credit can't both pass. If any step then fails, the failure path refunds it.

## Two images per render
`render.jpg` — corrected, **no branding**
`branded.jpg` — corrected + logo/contact

Corrections re-render from `render.jpg`. Pointing them at the branded copy stamped the logo again on every correction.

## Failure path
Every step that can realistically throw routes its error output here: the row is set to `failed` and any credit taken is refunded.

The app polls that row. Without this, an error stranded it on `processing` and the user watched a spinner forever.

## What the app sends here
`{ render_id, user_id, photo_url, color_hex, color_name, colors[], surface, prompt, brand_logo_url, brand_contact }`

Correction call:
`{ render_id, user_id, correction_prompt, surface, brand_logo_url, brand_contact }`

`surface` is the "Paint the" text. `colors[]` holds up to three picks; `color_hex` is the single colour the LAB pass locks to.
